name: HTTP 5xx spike
description: The service error rate rose from below 1% to 38% while traffic remained stable.
ground_truth: Unhandled application exception in the request handler

logs.message: ERROR request failed status=500 ValueError: invalid account state in create_session handler

name: CPU saturation
description: Request latency increased and application CPU usage remains above the configured threshold.
ground_truth: CPU saturation caused by a compute-intensive request loop

name: Container OOMKilled
description: The application pod restarted repeatedly after a rapid loss of availability.
ground_truth: Container exceeded its memory limit and was OOMKilled

kubernetes_events.message: Container terminated with reason OOMKilled after exceeding memory limit 256Mi

name: Database connection refused
description: Requests requiring persistence fail immediately while stateless health checks remain successful.
ground_truth: PostgreSQL endpoint refused TCP connections on port 5432

logs.message: ERROR psycopg.OperationalError connection to db.internal port 5432 failed: Connection refused

name: Slow response
description: The service p99 response time increased above 1.5 seconds without an increase in errors or CPU.
ground_truth: A slow database query is causing high request latency

logs.message: WARNING slow query duration_ms=1732 operation=SELECT user_profile rows=1

name: DNS resolution failure
description: Calls to one internal dependency fail before a connection can be established.
ground_truth: The dependency hostname cannot be resolved by cluster DNS

logs.message: ERROR socket.gaierror: Name or service not known host=payments.apps.svc.cluster.local DNS NXDOMAIN

name: Certificate expiry
description: TLS requests to an external dependency started failing while plain TCP connectivity remains available.
ground_truth: The dependency TLS certificate has expired

logs.message: ERROR TLS handshake failed: x509 certificate has expired or is not yet valid; NotAfter=2026-09-03T00:00:00Z

name: Dependency timeout
description: Calls to one upstream consume the full client timeout and then return 504 responses.
ground_truth: The payments upstream accepts connections but times out before responding

logs.message: ERROR upstream request failed dependency=payments error=ReadTimeout connected=true timeout_seconds=5 status=504

name: Disk pressure
description: A pod was evicted after node storage availability degraded.
ground_truth: Node ephemeral storage exhaustion caused DiskPressure and pod eviction

kubernetes_events.message: The node had condition DiskPressure and was low on resource: ephemeral-storage

name: Image pull failure
description: A newly requested replica remains unavailable before its container starts.
ground_truth: The configured container image tag does not exist in ECR

kubernetes_events.message: Failed to pull image 863547508328.dkr.ecr.ap-southeast-1.amazonaws.com/benchmark:missing: manifest unknown: Requested image not found

name: Resource quota exceeded
description: The Deployment cannot create the requested replicas in its namespace.
ground_truth: Namespace ResourceQuota prevents creation of another pod

kubernetes_events.message: Error creating: pods aiops-benchmark-service is forbidden: exceeded quota apps-compute, requested: limits.cpu=500m

name: Liveness probe failure
description: The container is running but repeatedly restarts and never remains Ready.
ground_truth: A failing HTTP liveness probe causes kubelet to restart the container

kubernetes_events.message: Liveness probe failed: HTTP probe returned statuscode: 500; container will be restarted

name: Network policy block
description: One internal dependency became unreachable immediately after a namespace policy change; DNS still resolves its service address.
ground_truth: A NetworkPolicy denies egress from the application to the dependency

logs.message: ERROR dependency request timed out host=inventory.apps.svc.cluster.local resolved_ip=10.0.12.77 port=8080

name: HPA thrashing
description: Replica count repeatedly oscillates between one and six while request volume remains periodic.
ground_truth: An overly sensitive HPA threshold and short stabilization window cause scaling thrash

kubernetes_events.message: New size: 6; reason: cpu resource utilization above target
New size: 1; reason: all metrics below target; four opposing rescale events occurred in 8 minutes

name: Vault secret synchronization failure
description: A rollout cannot obtain its required application credentials after secret reconciliation.
ground_truth: External Secrets Operator cannot read the configured Vault secret path

logs.message: ERROR reconcile failed provider=vault path=apps/aiops-benchmark credentials: secret not found

kubernetes_events.message: ExternalSecret failed to retrieve secret from Vault path apps/aiops-benchmark/credentials: secret not found
